These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{environment_name}/secrets`

Create a secret

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Stores a secret value encrypted, for the environment's storage, a webhook, a package index or a repository. The value is never shown again. Needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in the environment. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist, 409 when a secret of that name exists, and 422 when the use names no target, or names one it must not. Answers 500 when the instance has no secrets master key; that is a deployment fault the operator fixes.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_name` | path | yes | text | The environment this secret is scoped to. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `SecretCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `values` | mapping of text to text | yes |  |
| `use` | `SecretBind` or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `SecretOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `SecretOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `created_by` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `created_at` | text (date-time) | yes |  |
| `rotated_at` | text (date-time) or null | no |  |
| `format_version` | whole number | yes |  |
| `key_id` | text | yes |  |
| `use` | text or null | no |  |
| `use_target` | text or null | no |  |
| `use_target_url` | text or null | no |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{environment_name}/secrets`

List the secrets of an environment

Lists the active secrets by name and use. Values are never included. Needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in the environment. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_name` | path | yes | text | The environment whose secrets to list. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `SecretOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `PATCH /api/v1/environments/{environment_name}/secrets/{secret_name}`

Rotate a secret

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Replaces the secret's value; what uses it picks the new value up. Needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in the environment. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist or has no active secret of that name (a revoked secret counts as missing), and 500 when the instance has no secrets master key.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_name` | path | yes | text | The environment the secret is scoped to. |
| `secret_name` | path | yes | text | The secret's name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `SecretRotate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | mapping of text to text | yes |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `SecretOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `SecretOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `name` | text | yes |  |

Needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in the environment. Answers 404 when the environment or secret does not exist.

## `PUT /api/v1/environments/{environment_name}/secrets/{secret_name}/use`

Bind a secret to a package index, repository or environment

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Chooses what uses the secret: a package index or repository by name, or the environment itself. Needs `MANAGE_SECRET` in the environment. Answers 404 when the environment, the active secret (a revoked secret counts as missing) or the target does not exist and 422 for a name given for the environment use, none for an index or repository, or the environment's storage secret bound to an index or repository.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_name` | path | yes | text | The environment the secret is scoped to. |
| `secret_name` | path | yes | text | The secret's name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `SecretBind`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of `package_index`, `repository`, `connection`, `environment` | yes |  |
| `target` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `SecretOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `SecretOut`
